engines.name: Amazon Search
engines.description: Scrapes results from the Amazon search page: organic products, ads, featured products, sponsored brands, videos, related searches, categories and filters. The query parameter is k and results can also be restricted to a category node.

params.name: k
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query as you would type it in an Amazon search. Can't be used with node.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.label: Amazon domain
params.help: Amazon domain to use. Defaults to amazon.com.

params.name: language
params.label: Language
params.help: Locale as <language>_<REGION> (e.g. en_US on amazon.com, ja_JP on amazon.co.jp). Valid values depend on the domain (shown in brackets).

options.label: English - EN - Translation [amazon.com.be, amazon.fr, amazon.de, amazon.it, amazon.nl, amazon.es, amazon.se, amazon.co.uk]

params.name: delivery_zip
params.label: Delivery ZIP / postal code
params.help: ZIP Postal code. To filter the shipping products by a selected area.

params.name: shipping_location
params.label: Shipping country
params.help: Shipping country. To filter the shipping products by a selected country.

params.name: s
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sort order of the results.

params.name: node
params.label: Category node ID
params.help: Amazon category node ID (e.g. 6563140011 for Smart Home on amazon.com). Can't be used with k.

params.name: rh
params.label: Attribute filters (rh)
params.help: Key:value pairs separated by commas, e.g. n:16318031,p_72:1248897011 (Coffee department, 4 stars & up).

params.name: dc
params.label: Exclude auto-corrected results
params.help: true excludes results from an auto-corrected query when the original query is misspelled; false (default) includes them.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (currently iPads) or mobile.

pagination.notes: page=1 is the first page. Page size is not documented; use serpapi_pagination.next / current to walk pages.

engines.aira_use: Research tools, books, courses, desk and home-office gear for a new role, and compare prices and ratings before buying interview or onboarding equipment.

engines.name: Amazon Product
engines.description: Scrapes an Amazon product page by ASIN: product details, price, purchase options, specifications, description, reviews information, related products, videos and other sellers.

params.name: asin
params.label: ASIN
params.help: Amazon Standard Identification Number of the product.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.label: Amazon domain
params.help: Parameter defines the Amazon domain to use. It defaults to amazon.com. Head to Amazon domains for a full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: language
params.label: Language
params.help: Parameter defines the language to use for the Amazon search. It's a locale name represented as <language>_<REGION>. (e.g., on amazon.com en_US for English, es_US for Spanish, or on amazon.co.jp ja_JP for Japanese). Head to Amazon languages for a full list of supported Amazon languages.

options.label: English - EN - Translation [amazon.com.be, amazon.fr, amazon.de, amazon.it, amazon.nl, amazon.es, amazon.se, amazon.co.uk]

params.name: delivery_zip
params.label: Delivery ZIP / postal code
params.help: ZIP Postal code. To filter the shipping products by a selected area.

params.name: shipping_location
params.label: Shipping country
params.help: Shipping country. To filter the shipping products by a selected country.

params.name: other_sellers
params.label: Include other sellers
params.help: Include results from other sellers.

params.name: all_related_products
params.label: All related products
params.help: true retrieves all items in related_products and related_product_sections, not just the first page (slower).

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (currently iPads) or mobile.

pagination.notes: Single product page. all_related_products=true expands related product lists.

engines.aira_use: Look up a specific book, course or gadget by ASIN to read specs, price, ratings and review summary before purchase.

engines.name: Amazon Autocomplete
engines.description: Returns keyword suggestions from Amazon's search autocomplete for a query, optionally scoped to a department.

params.name: k
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query to complete.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.label: Amazon domain
params.help: Parameter defines the Amazon domain to use. It defaults to amazon.com. Head to Amazon domains for a full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: amazon_department
params.label: Department
params.help: Amazon department to scope suggestions to. Defaults to aps (All Departments). The department list is domain specific; amazon.com values are shown.

pagination.notes: Single suggestions list.

engines.aira_use: Discover what people search for around a topic (tools, certifications, books) to guide learning and product research.

engines.name: Amazon Promotion
engines.description: Scrapes Amazon promotion pages: coupon or promotion details, terms, schedule, how to claim, and (optionally) the products it applies to.

params.name: promotion_id
params.label: Promotion ID
params.help: ID in the promotion's /promotion/psp/[PROMOTION ID] page URL, e.g. A1C1U2DDI9B2GB.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.label: Amazon domain
params.help: Amazon domain to use. amazon.cn is not supported for promotions.

params.name: language
params.label: Language
params.help: Parameter defines the language to use for the Amazon search. It's a locale name represented as <language>_<REGION>. (e.g., on amazon.com en_US for English, es_US for Spanish, or on amazon.co.jp ja_JP for Japanese). Head to Amazon languages for a full list of supported Amazon languages.

options.label: English - EN - Translation [amazon.com.be, amazon.fr, amazon.de, amazon.it, amazon.nl, amazon.es, amazon.se, amazon.co.uk]

params.name: include_products
params.label: Include qualifying products
params.help: true retrieves items qualifying for the promotion (slower); false (default) returns only promotion details.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (currently iPads) or mobile.

pagination.notes: Single promotion page; include_products=true adds qualifying_items.

engines.aira_use: Check coupon and promotion terms for tools or learning material before purchasing.

engines.name: eBay Search
engines.description: Scrapes the eBay search results page: listings with price, shipping, condition, seller, buying format, plus categories, inline results and related searches. The query parameter is _nkw.

params.name: _nkw
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query as in a regular eBay search. Optional when category_id is specified.

params.name: ebay_domain
params.label: eBay domain
params.help: eBay domain to use. Defaults to ebay.com.

params.name: _salic
params.label: Item location (country)
params.help: Location based on country; value is eBay numeric country code (1 United States, 2 Canada, 3 United Kingdom...).

params.name: _pgn
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: _ipg
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Parameter defines the maximum number of results to return. There are three options: 60 (default), 120 and 240 results.

params.name: _blrs
params.label: Spell correction
params.help: Set to spell_auto_correct to exclude results from an auto-corrected query. Omit to include them.

params.name: show_only
params.label: Show only
params.help: Filters to apply (case-sensitive), comma-separated, e.g. FS,RPA. Sold and Complete are deprecated.

params.name: buying_format
params.label: Buying format
params.help: Buying format filter (case-sensitive).

params.name: _sasl
params.label: Seller usernames
params.help: Seller username(s) to filter by, comma-separated (e.g. iRobot,samsung). Use with _saslop.

params.name: _saslop
params.label: Seller filter mode
params.help: Include or exclude items from the sellers in _sasl.

params.name: popular_filters
params.label: Popular filters
params.help: Attribute filters as key=value pairs separated by & (e.g. Brand=Nespresso&Size=L); join multiple values with | (Brand=adidas|Majestic). Values come from popular_filters[].parameter in the response.

params.name: _udlo
params.label: Minimum price
params.help: Lowest price of items to include.

params.name: _udhi
params.label: Maximum price
params.help: Highest price of items to include.

params.name: _sop
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sort option (default Best Match). Some options are unavailable on certain eBay domains.

options.label: Price: highest first (unavailable: Unavailable for the following ebay_domain: - ebay.com)
Price: lowest first (unavailable: Unavailable for the following ebay_domain: - ebay.com)
Condition: new first (unavailable: Unavailable for the following ebay_domain: - ebay.ca - ebay.de - ebay.com.my - ebay.nl - ebay.com.sg - ebay.co.uk - ebay.com)
Condition: used first (unavailable: Unavailable for the following ebay_domain: - ebay.ca - ebay.de - ebay.com.my - ebay.nl - ebay.com.sg - ebay.co.uk - ebay.com)

params.name: _dmd
params.label: Layout
params.help: Visual layout for displaying results: 'Grid' or 'List'.

params.name: category_id
params.label: Category ID
params.help: Category to concentrate the search in; IDs are in categories[].id of the JSON output. Can be used without _nkw.

params.name: _stpos
params.label: ZIP / postal code
params.help: ZIP or postal code used to filter shipping products by area.

params.name: LH_ItemCondition
params.label: Item condition IDs
params.help: Product condition IDs joined with | (e.g. 1000|3000; 1000 is New). See eBay condition-id values. Undocumented ID 10 means Not Specified.

params.name: LH_PrefLoc
params.label: Preferred location
params.help: Parameter defines the preferred location. The available options are 'Domestic', 'Regional', and 'Worldwide'.

pagination.notes: _pgn is the page number; _ipg sets items per page (60 default, 120, 240).

engines.aira_use: Find second-hand laptops, monitors, books and equipment cheaply for studying, freelancing or a home office.

engines.name: eBay Product
engines.description: Scrapes an eBay product (listing) page: title, price/buy options, shipping, returns, specifications, seller information and related products.

params.name: product_id
params.label: Product (item) ID
params.help: ID of the product; found in links https://www.ebay.com/itm/{product_id}.

params.name: ebay_domain
params.label: eBay domain
params.help: Parameter defines the eBay domain to use. It defaults to ebay.com. Head to the eBay domains for a full list of supported domains.

params.name: locale
params.label: Locale (origin country)
params.help: Where the search originates from (eBay locale code, e.g. US, CA, GB).

params.name: lang
params.label: Language
params.help: Language for the search; defaults to en-US. Available only for the United States eBay domain and only when locale is set.

params.name: shipping_country
params.label: Shipping country
params.help: Country used for shipping data calculation (eBay country code).

pagination.notes: Single product page.

engines.aira_use: Inspect a specific equipment listing and seller reputation before buying.

engines.name: eBay Seller
engines.description: Scrapes an eBay seller or store page: seller profile, followers, feedback and the seller's listings.

params.name: seller_id
params.label: Seller ID
params.help: Seller ID; found in the username field of eBay Search/Product results or seller links https://www.ebay.com/usr/{seller_id}.

params.name: type
params.label: Seller type
params.help: Type of the seller: user or store. Detect it with the eBay Product API.

params.name: ebay_domain
params.label: eBay domain
params.help: Parameter defines the eBay domain to use. It defaults to ebay.com. Head to the eBay domains for a full list of supported domains.

params.name: _pgn
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: _ipg
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Parameter defines the maximum number of results to return. There are three options: 24, 48 (default), and 72 results.

params.name: _sop
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Parameter defines results sorted by different options in the eBay. The default option is 'Best Match'. Available options: 12 - Best Match 1 - Time ending soonest 10 - Time newly listed 15 - Price + Shipping: lowest first 16 - Price + Shipping: highest first 7 - Distance: nearest first

params.name: buying_format
params.label: Buying format
params.help: Parameter defines the buying format you can apply to the results. The default option is 'All Listings'. Available options: 0 - All Listings 1 - Buy It Now 2 - Auction

params.name: LH_ItemCondition
params.label: Item condition IDs
params.help: Condition numeric IDs joined with |: 3 New, 4 Used, 10 Not Specified (e.g. 3|4).

params.name: free_shipping
params.label: Free shipping only
params.help: Show only products with free shipping.

pagination.notes: _pgn is the page number; _ipg sets items per page (24, 48 default, 72).

engines.aira_use: Vet a seller (feedback, items sold) before purchasing refurbished work equipment.

engines.name: Walmart Search
engines.description: Scrapes the Walmart search page for walmart.com (US) and walmart.com.mx (Mexico): organic products, filters, related queries, spell check and pagination.

params.name: query
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query as in a regular Walmart search. Either query or cat_id is required.

params.name: walmart_domain
params.label: Walmart domain
params.help: Walmart domain to use. Defaults to walmart.com.

params.name: sort
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sorting. best_seller, rating_high and new are not supported for walmart.com.mx.

params.name: soft_sort
params.label: Soft sort by relevance
params.help: Enables/disables sort by relevance. Set to false to disable. Not supported for walmart.com.mx.

params.name: cat_id
params.label: Category ID
params.help: Category (0 = all departments, 976759_976787 = Cookies). Either query or cat_id is required. Not supported for walmart.com.mx.

params.name: facet
params.label: Facet filters
params.help: Attribute filters as key:value pairs separated by || (key and value separated by :).

params.name: store_id
params.label: Store ID
params.help: Walmart store ID to filter products by a specific store (pricing can differ between stores). See the Walmart Stores Locations list in the docs.

params.name: min_price
params.label: Minimum price
params.help: Lower bound of price range query.

params.name: max_price
params.label: Maximum price
params.help: Upper bound of price range query.

params.name: spelling
params.label: Spelling fix
params.help: true (default) includes spelling fix, false searches without it.

params.name: nd_en
params.label: Next-day delivery only
params.help: Show results with NextDay delivery only. Not supported for walmart.com.mx.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (currently iPads) or mobile.

params.name: include_filters
params.label: Include filters
params.help: Include filters in the JSON response (true) or not (false, default).

pagination.notes: Maximum page value is 100.

engines.aira_use: Compare prices for office supplies and everyday gear when relocating or setting up a workspace.

params.name: rating

params.name: page

params.name: product_id

params.name: store_id

engines.name: The Home Depot Search
engines.description: Real-time product search on The Home Depot (US and Canada): products with price, rating, delivery and pickup, plus taxonomy, filters and related products.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Parameter defines the search query. You can use anything that you would use in a regular The Home Depot search.

params.name: country
params.label: Country
params.help: Only United States (us) and Canada (ca) are supported.

params.name: hd_sort
params.label: Sort by (US)
params.help: Sort order for Home Depot US.

params.name: hd_filter_tokens
params.label: Filter tokens (US)
params.help: Filter tokens divided by comma; obtain them from the API response (filters).

params.name: delivery_zip
params.label: Delivery ZIP / postal code
params.help: ZIP Postal code. To filter the shipping products by a selected area.

params.name: store_id
params.label: Store ID (US)
params.help: Store ID to filter products by a specific Home Depot US store.

params.name: store
params.label: Store (Canada)
params.help: Store ID to filter by a specific store in Home Depot Canada. Default store is Gatineau (7140).

params.name: sort
params.label: Sort by (Canada)
params.help: Sort order for Home Depot Canada.

params.name: filter
params.label: Filter tokens (Canada)
params.help: Filter tokens divided by dash (-) for Home Depot Canada; obtain them from the API response.

params.name: lowerbound
params.label: Lower price bound (USD)
params.help: Defines lower bound for price in USD.

params.name: upperbound
params.label: Upper price bound (USD)
params.help: Defines upper bound for price in USD.

params.name: minmax
params.label: Price range (CAD)
params.help: Lower and upper price bound in CAD, Canada only. Examples: price:[100 TO 500], price:[100 TO *], price:[0 TO 500].

params.name: nao
params.label: Offset
params.help: Offset for products result. A page holds 24 products: 0, 24, 48...

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: ps
params.label: Items per page (US)
params.help: Number of items per page. Home Depot may override it; default and maximum is 24.

params.name: pagesize
params.label: Items per page (Canada)
params.help: Number of items per page in Home Depot Canada. Default and maximum is 40.

pagination.notes: US: 24 products per page (max); nao is the equivalent offset (0, 24, 48...). Canada: pagesize default/max 40.

engines.name: The Home Depot Product Reviews

engines.name: Target Search
engines.description: Scrapes products from Target search results: TCIN, title, brand, price and deals, rating and reviews, badges and availability for pickup, same-day delivery and shipping.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query as in a regular Target search (e.g. coffee, 65 inch tv, lego star wars).

params.name: store_id
params.label: Store ID
params.help: Target store for prices and availability (number at the end of the store page URL, e.g. 1375 for Mpls Nicollet Mall). Defaults to 1771.

params.name: delivery_zip
params.label: Delivery ZIP
params.help: US ZIP code to deliver to (e.g. 10001), used for shipping dates and same-day delivery. Defaults to the store location.

params.name: sort
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sorting of the results. Sponsored products are shown only when sorted by relevance.

params.name: facet
params.label: Facet filters
params.help: Comma-separated list of filter IDs (e.g. 5tdv0,4yagy). IDs are in filters[].options[].id when include_filters is true. Setting facet replaces Target's automatic filters.

params.name: category_id
params.label: Category ID
params.help: Category to search in (e.g. hz89j for Kitchen & Dining); IDs are in the Category filter when include_filters is true.

params.name: min_price
params.label: Minimum price (USD)
params.help: Parameter defines the minimum price of the products, in US dollars (e.g., 10).

params.name: max_price
params.label: Maximum price (USD)
params.help: Parameter defines the maximum price of the products, in US dollars (e.g., 50).

params.name: spelling
params.label: Spelling fix
params.help: true (default) searches the spelling fix; false searches for the query as typed.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

params.name: include_filters
params.label: Include filters
params.help: Include the filters of the search in the JSON response, with IDs to use in facet and category_id.

pagination.notes: Up to 24 results per page plus sponsored products, and up to 50 pages.

engines.aira_use: Compare prices of everyday and office items at Target for a move or new workspace.

engines.name: Facebook Profile
engines.description: Scrapes a public Facebook profile or page: name, ID, followers, category, contact details, business hours, links and photos.

params.name: profile_id
params.label: Profile ID
params.help: Facebook profile ID from the URL: Meta for https://www.facebook.com/Meta, or 100080376596424 for profile.php?id=100080376596424.

pagination.notes: Single profile page.

engines.aira_use: Research a company's public Facebook page (size, contacts, culture photos) before applying or networking.

engines.name: Instagram Profile
engines.description: Scrapes a public Instagram profile: biography, links, followers, verification and recent posts, with token-based pagination.

params.name: profile_id
params.label: Profile ID
params.help: Instagram profile ID from the URL, e.g. serpapicom for https://www.instagram.com/serpapicom.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for retrieving the next page; found in serpapi_pagination -> next_page_token.

pagination.notes: Pass serpapi_pagination.next_page_token from the previous response.

engines.aira_use: Review a company's or recruiter's public Instagram presence for culture and hiring signals.

engines.name: Yelp Reviews
engines.description: Scrapes the reviews of a Yelp place with rating, comment, date, user, photos and feedback, with language breakdown and optional not-recommended reviews.

params.name: place_id
params.label: Place ID
params.help: Yelp ID of a place. Only the first ID type is supported (e.g. ED7A7vDdg8yLNKJTSVHHmg). Get it from Yelp Search.

params.name: yelp_domain
params.label: Yelp domain
params.help: Parameter defines the Yelp domain to use. It defaults to yelp.com. Head to the Yelp domains for a full list of supported Yelp domains.

params.name: hl
params.label: Review language
params.help: Language to use for sorting Yelp reviews (two-letter code).

params.name: q
params.label: Search within reviews
params.help: Query to search through Yelp reviews.

params.name: sortby
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Parameter is used for sorting results. Available options: relevance_desc - Yelp Sort (default) date_desc - Newest First date_asc - Oldest Rated rating_desc - Highest Rated rating_asc - Lowest Rated elites_desc - Elites

params.name: rating
params.label: Ratings
params.help: Filter by rating(s): 5, or several separated by comma (5,4,3). All by default.

params.name: not_recommended
params.label: Not recommended only
params.help: true shows only reviews not recommended by Yelp; false (default) shows recommended reviews.

params.name: start
params.label: Start (offset)
params.help: Result offset: 0 (default), 49 second page, 98 third page.

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Maximum number of results to return; 49 (default and maximum).

params.name: not_recommended_start
params.label: Not-recommended start
params.help: Result offset for not-recommended reviews (0, 10, 20...). Only with not_recommended=true.

pagination.notes: start is the result offset (0, 49, 98...); num max 49. not_recommended_start (step 10) paginates not-recommended reviews.

engines.aira_use: Read customer reviews of an employer's local business or a venue.

engines.name: OpenTable Reviews
engines.description: Scrapes reviews of an OpenTable restaurant: summary ratings, AI summary and paged diner reviews.

params.name: rid
params.label: Restaurant ID
params.help: Path of the restaurant URL after the first /, e.g. r/central-park-boathouse-new-york-2 for https://www.opentable.com/r/central-park-boathouse-new-york-2.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

pagination.notes: page=1 is the first page of 10 reviews.

engines.aira_use: Pick a well-reviewed restaurant for a networking dinner or interview lunch.

engines.name: Zillow Search
engines.description: Scrapes real estate listings from Zillow (sale, rent, sold) with property details, pricing, availability, Zestimates and rich filters.

params.name: region_id
params.label: Region ID
params.help: Zillow region ID (city, neighborhood, ZIP, county or state), e.g. 10221 for Austin, TX; the number before _rid in the Zillow URL. Either region_id or map_bounds should be set (or both).

params.name: map_bounds
params.label: Map bounds (N,E,S,W)
params.help: north,east,south,west coordinates, e.g. 30.51,-97.56,30.14,-98.05 for Austin, TX. Either region_id or map_bounds should be set (or both).

params.name: status_type
params.label: Listing status type
params.help: Type of properties to show; also determines which filters apply.

params.name: price
params.label: Price range
params.help: Single number for a minimum (100000) or min,max (100000,400000); max only: ,400000. For rent it is monthly rent.

params.name: beds
params.label: Bedrooms
params.help: Single number for a minimum (2) or min,max (1,3); max only: ,3.

params.name: baths
params.label: Bathrooms
params.help: Single number for a minimum (2) or min,max (1,3); max only: ,3.

params.name: home_type
params.label: Home types
params.help: Comma-separated complete selection of types to show (e.g. house,condo). Options depend on status_type; for rent: house, apartment_condo, townhome.

params.name: sqft
params.label: Square footage
params.help: Single number for a minimum (1250) or min,max (1250,3000); max only: ,3000.

params.name: year_built
params.label: Year built
params.help: Single year for a minimum (2000) or min,max (2000,2010); max only: ,2010.

params.name: has_garage
params.label: Has garage
params.help: true shows only properties with a garage.

params.name: single_story
params.label: Single story only
params.help: true shows only single-story properties.

params.name: age_55_plus
params.label: 55+ communities
params.help: Parameter defines how to handle 55+ communities. It defaults to include. Available options: include - Include 55+ communities exclude - Exclude 55+ communities only - Only show 55+ communities

params.name: amenities
params.label: Amenities
params.help: Comma-separated amenities the properties must have (e.g. ac,pool). Options depend on status_type.

params.name: view
params.label: Views
params.help: Comma-separated views the properties must have (e.g. city,water).

params.name: price_reduction
params.label: Price reduction only
params.help: true shows only properties with a price reduction.

params.name: time_on_zillow
params.label: Time on Zillow
params.help: Maximum listing time: a number of days (e.g. 14) or 6m, 12m, 24m, 36m. Defaults to any time.

params.name: keywords
params.label: Keywords
params.help: Comma-separated keywords to filter results by (e.g. yard or pool, bbq).

params.name: hoa_max
params.label: Max HOA fee
params.help: Maximum HOA fee; 0 = no HOA fee. Only when status_type is sale or sold.

params.name: parking_spots
params.label: Minimum parking spots
params.help: Minimum number of parking spots. Only when status_type is sale or sold.

params.name: lot_size
params.label: Lot size (sq ft)
params.help: Single number for a minimum (21780) or min,max; max only: ,217800. Only when status_type is sale or sold.

params.name: basement
params.label: Basement
params.help: Basement types (e.g. finished,unfinished). Only when status_type is sale or sold.

params.name: listing_type
params.label: Listing types
params.help: Complete list of listing types to show. Only when status_type is sale. Default: owner,agent,new_construction,foreclosure,auction.

params.name: listing_status
params.label: Listing statuses
params.help: Complete list of statuses to show. Only when status_type is sale. Default: active,coming_soon,zillow_preview.

params.name: tours
params.label: Tours
params.help: Tour options the properties must have. Only when status_type is sale.

params.name: space
params.label: Rental space
params.help: Type of rental space. Only when status_type is rent.

params.name: move_in_date
params.label: Move-in date
params.help: Latest move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only when status_type is rent.

params.name: hide_no_date_listings
params.label: Hide rentals without date
params.help: true hides rentals without an availability date. Use with move_in_date; rent only.

params.name: pets
params.label: Pet policies
params.help: Pet policies the rentals must have; no_pets cannot be combined with others. Rent only.

params.name: listing_features
params.label: Listing features
params.help: Listing features rentals must have. Rent only.

params.name: short_term_lease
params.label: Short-term lease only
params.help: true shows only rentals with a short-term lease. Rent only.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sorting order. For rent use paymenta/paymentd instead of pricea/priced.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number for pagination (1 is the first page).

pagination.notes: page=1 is the first page; see search_information.results_per_page / total_pages.

engines.aira_use: Research housing and rent costs when relocating for a job offer or comparing salaries across cities.
